newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TEXT OF ROMANIA FOREIGN INVESTMENT DECREE (4 OF 7).
newsitem.headline: TEXT OF ROMANIA FOREIGN INVESTMENT DECREE (4 OF 7).

text.p: (This is an unofficial translation of Romania's government Decree no.31/16.06.1997 on foreign investment. The unofficial translation was provided by Price Waterhouse Romania.
For any querries please contact Price Waterhouse at telephone +40-1 311-2455, fax +40-1 312-3334.)
Legal status of the portfolio investments made by foreign investors

Art 11. - (1) A portfolio investment shall be the purchase (hereinafter reffered to as transaction) of securities, including state bonds, from the organised securites markets, as provided by Law No. 52 of 1994 regarding securities and stock exchanges, by a natural or legal person which is not a resident of Romania, through the agency of an entity authorised, according to law, by the National Securities Commision.

(2) The aquisition of securities, including state bonds, in the terms defined in paragraph (1) above is subject to the same legal status, irrespective whether it was achieved following a public offer, a private placement or as an effect of other transactions on the organised securities markets or of an issuance of certificates of deposits of securities promoted by an issuer or holder of securities registred with the Securities Record Office of the National Securities Commision.

Art. 12 - The operations of repatriation of the invested capital and income resulting from such investment shall be made based on the confirmation of the initial foreign exchange and the statements of account issued by the securities companies or by agents authorised thereto for by the National Securities Commision, whereby it is proven that the funds available on account derive from one or several transactions with securities acquired as per Article 11, or from dividends, payments or interest accruing to the securities owned, as the case may be.
Art. 13 - (1) The transactions in securities made pursuant Article 11 shall be taxed up to 1.5 percent of the total amount of each such transaction.

(2) The amounts relating to the tax provided for in the preceding paragraph are withheld from the purchaser by the securities company whereby the transaction is carried out, and are paid to the state budget within maximum 10 days from their collection.

(3) In the case of the failiure to comply with the timming provided in paragraph (2) for the making of the payments to the state budget the securities company shall be obliged to pay a penalty of 0.25 percent for each day of delay, applicable to the amount collected as transaction tax.
Art. 14 - (1) The repatriation of the income shall be effected exclusively in the freely convertible currency in which the initial investment was made.
(2) The National Bank of Romania shall monitor and keep distinctive records of all foreign exchange operations related to the portfolio investment made by foreign investors.

(3) The amount of the tax stipulated in art.13, paragraph (1) is to be set on a semester basis, until the 25-th of the current month for the following semester, by the Reform Council, along with the National Bank of Romania.

Art. 15 The capital flows in lei resulting from the purchases of shares from the secondary markets shall be distinctively recorded by the securities companies and reported monthly to the National Securities Commision.
